description: Fresh chat requests for the confirmation run in tier_choice_variants.md. Written 2026-11-10 so that a request's length does not give away its tier: long easy requests and short hard ones. UNLABELLED: Jeevan fills in every "tier" with fast, smart or ultra, using the rule below, before any candidate is scored on it. The order is shuffled.

labelling_rule.fast: One short answer the fast model gives well: greetings and small talk, a fact or definition, a short rewrite, a quick how-to, a one-line snippet. Length alone does not make a request harder.
labelling_rule.smart: A structured answer over several steps: an explanation of a mechanism, a comparison with trade-offs, a plan, a function or a bug fix of ordinary size, constrained writing, a diagnosis with several possible causes.
labelling_rule.ultra: Long, careful reasoning where one wrong step ruins the answer: proofs and derivations, logic puzzles, system design, multi-part debugging, or an explicit request for the biggest model or the deepest answer.

labelled_by: Jeevan (q001-q024) and Claude at Jeevan's request (q025-q120), 2026-11-11
